The Village of Hollow Mourning — Shuttered houses lean against each other like mourners at a grave. No smoke rises from any chimney, yet you feel watched from every window.
The Buried Chapel — Half-sunk into the earth, a small chapel holds a crumbling diary and an altar stained dark with something older than paint.
The Keeper of Tolls — A pale figure in a tollkeeper's coat waits at a bridge that leads nowhere. 'Everyone pays here,' he says. 'The question is only what.'
Ambush at the Crossroads — Bones stir beneath the crossroads stones. The dead rise, jaws clacking with a hunger older than memory.
The Sealed Crypt — A crypt door is bound shut with rune-carved iron. Something within it hums, waiting to be understood or broken.
The Grieving Widow — A woman in tattered mourning clothes tends a grave that never fills. She has waited generations for someone to listen.

The Wight of Broken Oaths — A knight who once swore loyalty and broke it rises from the crypt floor, its blade still gleaming with unfinished business.
